data.one_liner: A Flutter package for multi-layered animated circular progress bars.
data.what_it_does: It helps creating multi-layered animated circular and linear progress bars to display multiple values in a single bar with different colors. It also includes support for total percentage display, custom center widgets, labels, and customizable stroke widths and colors.
use_when: You need to show multiple progress or value proportions inside a single circular or linear bar.
You want built-in animations for your progress values.
avoid_when: You need complex data visualization charts like line, bar, or pie charts with axes and data points.
strengths: Supports displaying multiple values in a single progress bar
Includes customizable animations, colors, and widths
Allows custom inner widgets and labels
weaknesses: Limited to progress bars and gauges rather than full charting capabilities
Values must sum up to 1.0 or less
data.minimal_example:
MultiCircularSlider(
    size: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.8,
    progressBarType: MultiCircularSliderType.circular,
    values: [0.2, 0.1, 0.3, 0.25],
    colors: [Color(0xFFFD1960), Color(0xFF29D3E8), Color(0xFF18C737), Color(0xFFFFCC05)],
    showTotalPercentage: true,
)
